environment: Windows local, Node 24.12.0, Vitest 3.2.4, Stryker 9.6.1; all actual agents GPT-6 Luna medium

protocol.singleMeaning: Framework Single: Planner plus one coding/test/self-review role, possibly multiple turns; no independent Author/Verifier.
protocol.policy: Two separate repositories cloned from same immutable scaffold before any model call. Same original SPEC/tools/model/effort/cap; run sequentially on one Windows machine. Freeze grader and product including uncommitted changes before first model. No manual candidate source/test/manifest edits, hidden grader feedback, discarded failed run, product/schema change mid-run or arbitrary model retry. Record legitimate contract/test-repair/warning/finding approvals with receipts. Grade every implementation, including blocked runs. Single external mutation same defaults/5-minute bound, timed separately. Only accept/deliver local benchmark branch after mandatory product evidence and frozen grader pass; warning acknowledgement never bypasses a blocker. No claims from test counts or general superiority from one trial.

adjudication.kind: Post-run grader defect adjudication, not a new model trial or discarded failure
adjudication.finding: The frozen grader assumed arrays must throw INVALID. SPEC clause 8 requires INVALID for null/non-object outer arguments, and only defines correct restoration for implementation-produced snapshots. An Array is a non-null JavaScript object, is not a produced snapshot, and its response is otherwise unspecified. The grader did not establish a required INVALID response.
adjudication.attribution: Benchmark TEST_SCRIPT defect, not a demonstrated Single application defect.
adjudication.decision: Keep original SPEC/grader and every raw result unchanged. Exclude this single unsupported assertion from the spec-founded comparison for BOTH arms; retain it as unscored with observed output. Do not alter candidate code, feed this result to model or claim a 95/95 Single score.
